typeProperties.script:
source(output(
		{AssociateAC ADNumber} as string,
		ScrubDate as string,
		EndDate as string,
		MbrKey as string,
		JobName as string,
		DispositionCode as string
	),
	allowSchemaDrift: true,
	validateSchema: false) ~> FlatFileSource
FlatFileSource derive(Calllist = substring(toString(JobName), toInteger(1), toInteger(3)),
		Market = $Marketcsv) ~> AddCallListandMarket
AddCallListandMarket split(isNull(MbrKey) == true(), disjoint: true) ~> ConditionalSplit@(IsNULLMember,ConditionalSplitDefaultOutput)
ConditionalSplit@ConditionalSplitDefaultOutput derive(EndDate = toDate(toString(EndDate, 'MM/dd/yyyy'), "MM/dd/yyyy"),
		ScrubDate = toDate(toString(ScrubDate, 'MM/dd/yyyy'), "MM/dd/yyyy")) ~> DataConversion
DataConversion sink(input(
		CALLLIST_PERM_SCRUB_STAGING_MARKET as string,
		CALLLIST_PERM_SCRUB_STAGING_END_DATE as timestamp 'dd-MM-yyyy',
		CALLLIST_PERM_SCRUB_STAGING_JOB_NAME as string,
		CALLLIST_PERM_SCRUB_STAGING_MEMBERNUMBER as string,
		CALLLIST_PERM_SCRUB_STAGING_ASSOCIATE as string,
		CALLLIST_PERM_SCRUB_STAGING_CALLLIST_CD as string,
		CALLLIST_PERM_SCRUB_STAGING_SCRUB_DATE as timestamp 'dd-MM-yyyy',
		CALLLIST_PERM_SCRUB_STAGING_DISPOSITION_CODE as string
	),
	allowSchemaDrift: true,
	validateSchema: false,
	stagingSchemaName: 'dbo',
	saveOrder: 10000,
	insertable:true,
	deletable:false,
	upsertable:false,
	updateable:false,
	keys:[],
	mapColumn(
		CALLLIST_PERM_SCRUB_STAGING_MARKET = Market,
		CALLLIST_PERM_SCRUB_STAGING_END_DATE = EndDate,
		CALLLIST_PERM_SCRUB_STAGING_JOB_NAME = JobName,
		CALLLIST_PERM_SCRUB_STAGING_MEMBERNUMBER = MbrKey,
		CALLLIST_PERM_SCRUB_STAGING_ASSOCIATE = {AssociateAC ADNumber},
		CALLLIST_PERM_SCRUB_STAGING_CALLLIST_CD = Calllist,
		CALLLIST_PERM_SCRUB_STAGING_SCRUB_DATE = ScrubDate,
		CALLLIST_PERM_SCRUB_STAGING_DISPOSITION_CODE = DispositionCode)) ~> OLEDBDestination
